name: Notta
summary: AI note taker that records, transcribes, translates and summarises meetings and audio files.
description: Notta records online meetings through a bot or on-device without a bot, transcribes uploaded audio, video and YouTube links, and produces summaries and action items. It also offers real-time translation, screen recording, a desktop app, an MCP connector and a hardware recorder. A Free plan is available; Pro costs $8.17 per month billed annually, and Business $16.67 per month. Its Memo device can be attached to a phone to record calls and in-person meetings.

howToUse.title: Open Notta
howToUse.description: Open Notta and start on the Free plan. Pro costs $8.17 per month billed annually, and Business is $16.67 per month, if you outgrow that plan.

howToUse.title: Record or upload
howToUse.description: Record an online meeting with the bot, or record on the device without a bot. You can also transcribe uploaded audio, video or YouTube links.

howToUse.title: Read summaries and translate
howToUse.description: Open the summaries and action items Notta produces, and turn on real-time translation when more than one language is spoken.

howToUse.title: Use Memo, screen recording or MCP
howToUse.description: Attach the Memo hardware recorder to a phone to record calls and in-person meetings, or use screen recording, the desktop app and the MCP connector.
